# Pinned: 0.31.1 changed expose()'s is_accessible enforcement to run
# unconditionally for every BaseView route (previously only auto-generated
# ModelView CRUD/nav routes were guarded this way - see admin_pages.py's
# BaseView pages, several of which rely on the old behaviour and do their
# own broader in-body permission check instead of a class-level
# is_accessible). Bumping this needs an audit of every BaseView whose
# class-level is_accessible is narrower than what its individual routes
# allow, not just a version bump - see e.g. admin_org_pages.OrganisationsView
# (is_accessible=superadmin-only) whose own /organisation route is meant to
# also allow org-admins via its own explicit check.
